units.source_text: 美麗與恐懼並存於塵世難以承受的重負被迫落在懦弱者的孩子肩上

en.t: Beauty and terror coexist in this dusty world, and an unbearable burden is forced onto the shoulders of a weak person's child.

units.source_text: 我們都是被無奈播下的情慾之種無法擺脫善與惡、罪與罰的宿命

en.t: We are all seeds of desire sown by helplessness, unable to escape the fate of good and evil, sin and punishment.

units.source_text: 我們只是無奈地彷徨與驚慌因為神沒賜給我們粉碎它們的力量和意志

en.t: We merely wander and panic helplessly, because God did not grant us the strength or will to shatter them.
Where are you wandering and drifting about?

units.source_text: 在批判、探討、重新認識著什麼？

en.t: What are you criticizing, examining, and trying to understand anew?

units.source_text: 哦，是空虛的夢，是不復存在的幻想

en.t: Ah, it is an empty dream, a fantasy that no longer exists.

units.source_text: 嘿，忘了喝酒，一切都是虛妄

en.t: Well, I forgot to drink; everything is vanity.

units.source_text: 仰望無邊無際的天空吧我們不過是飄浮的一個小點

en.t: Look up at the boundless sky; we are nothing more than a tiny point floating in it.

units.source_text: 誰能知道這地球的自轉？

en.t: Who can understand the rotation of this Earth?
